s3.ptxt: Turn back the dash silencer from the slit in the dash silencer.
Measure the shortest distance from the brake pedal pad to the dash panel.
Disconnect the stop light switch connector.
Loosen the clevis lock nut, and turn the push rod to adjust the pedal height.
Insert the stop light switch into the adjuster until the stop light switch contacts the brake pedal.

item.ptxt: Do not push in the brake pedal when inserting the stop light switch.
Perform the work while supporting the brake pedal so that it is pulled up.

s3.ptxt: Turn the stop light switch approximately 1/4 turn clockwise.

item.ptxt: Do not push in the brake pedal when inserting the stop light switch.
Perform the work while supporting the brake pedal so that it is pulled up.
The turning torque of the stop light switch when turned clockwise should be 1.5N*m {15kgf*cm} or less.

s3.ptxt: Connect the stop light switch connector.
Check the shaft protrusion (amount of projection).
Check that the stop lights do not illuminate when the brake pedal is not depressed.

s2.ptxt: After stopping the engine, depress the pedal firmly several times until there is no vacuum in the brake booster.
Inspect the brake pedal free play.

s3.ptxt: If the free play is 1mm or less, check the shaft protrusion of the stop light switch assembly.

item.ptxt: If the shaft protrusion is out of the standard range, adjust the shaft protrusion of the stop light switch assembly.
If the shaft protrusion is within the standard range, the brake pedal is normal even if the free play is 1mm or less.

atten4.ptxt: Measure at the same point as for the brake pedal height inspection.

s2.ptxt: Inspect the brake pedal reserve distance.
